messages:
Nora K: quick FYI — bringing up NimbusPay's LoRA adapter on int4. intermittently the model truncates numeric fields in receipts/invoices. short repro below.
Devin M: paste the exact prompt?
Nora K: `Receipt: Order #A1007 total: $4,200.00 ->` sometimes it emits just the prefix and ends with EOS. happens more when ctx>2048 and batch>1.
Ravi S: tokenizer mismatch? any adapter-added tokens?
Nora K: checked token ids; commas/periods unchanged. no new tokens.
Ava T: could be quant folding bug. did you compare folded weight stats vs fp16?
Nora K: ran a smoke quickpack — numeric-extract dropped ~5.5% vs fp16; latency improved.
Devin M: run this focused job: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model nimbuspay/lora --quant int4 --suite numeric --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --dump-attn --dump-weight-stats` and also `--disable-fused-attn` variant.
Ravi S: try sampling=greedy and temp=0 to rule out sampling. also `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` if available.
Ava T: add `--kv-warmup 2` and `--dump-attn-step 8-14`. look for last-layer norm collapse. suspect missing clamp when folding LoRA deltas.
Nora K: kicked off CI: ci/evals-nimbus-int4-501 by @Nora K (inference-eval:canary).
ci-bot: job/501 started
Nora K: snippet from logs: ```
[prompt] Receipt: Order #A1007 total: $4,200.00 ->
[emit] "Receipt: Order #A1007 total: "
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[attn] last_layer_max: 2.7e-05
```
Devin M: eos early is suspicious. fp16 baseline still OK?
Nora K: fp16 clean. so int4 path only.
Ravi S: run `RUNNER_DEBUG=quant,kernels` for verbose kernel outputs and dump folded weight min/max. if clamp missing we should see extreme zeros or reduced dynamic range.
Ava T: mitigation plan: 1) add clamp in quantizer when folding LoRA; 2) unit test folding+decode on invoice tokens; 3) canary rollout at 2% with numeric-extract monitoring and automatic fallback to fp16 for affected tenants.
Nora K: uploaded traces + quickpack artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nimbus/501/ (notebook + 30 invoice prompts). will open a PR for quant-clamp + test.
ci-bot: job/501 completed: SUCCESS (artifacts uploaded)
